articles.summary: The NikeSKIMS Waffle Racer carries forward the iconic waffle traction pattern and low-profile racing shape of the original Nike Waffle Racer, joined by the NikeSKIMS Retro Sport collection of timeless sport styles.
articles.title: The NikeSKIMS Waffle Racer and Retro Sport Collection Reimagine Classic Sport Style

articles.summary: Nike and Kids Of Immigrants continue to celebrate football as a universal language, connecting cultures and generations in a new footwear collaboration that brings the global communities of both brands together through the beautiful game.
articles.title: Nike and Kids Of Immigrants Return With a New Footwear Collection for the Football Pitch and Streets

articles.summary: Nike has extended its partnership with Oregon State University through 2031 and added Beavers athletes Braden Atkinson and Jesse Legree to its Blue Ribbon Elite NIL roster.
articles.title: Nike Extends Long-Term Partnership With Oregon State and Signs Two Blue Ribbon Elite NIL Athletes
